system.text:
The Fêa trait denotes that this Elf has been born into a family whose lineage typically holds the rank of prince. This character need not hold the rank of prince himself, but possessing this trait indicates that he is eligible for the rank. This trait is required if the player wishes to take the Prince lifepath for his character.

Type: Char (character trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Elven lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 325
